description: Integer-native endogenous spontaneous activity over a discovered effector topology: homeostatic ignition, one-hop wave propagation, refractoriness, single compound collapse and verified reafferent learning, with one-shot structural ignition priors.

rules.name: smw_instantiate_situated_somatomotor_wave_field
rules.comment: The body topology, not anatomy or a canonical pose, is the excitable sheet. The field has no action until development opens a situated floor ecology.

rules.name: smw_instantiate_excitable_cell_for_each_effector_channel
rules.comment: One excitable cell per mechanically discovered command channel, not per opposing command polarity. Its ordinal is identity only; wave dynamics determine recruitment.

rules.name: smw_instantiate_passive_body_model_per_effector_channel
rules.comment: Exafferent motion gets its own predictive model. It is not an action model and never receives output authority.

rules.name: smw_bind_forward_topological_wave_coupling
rules.comment: Mechanical adjacency supplies only a possible propagation path. Receipt-grounded use changes its integer strength.

rules.name: smw_bind_reverse_topological_wave_coupling
rules.comment: Mechanical adjacency supplies only a possible propagation path. Receipt-grounded use changes its integer strength.

rules.name: smw_warm_start_structurally_matching_coupling_hint
rules.comment: A source-body coupling supplies only a one-shot rank hint when body ShapeDecode coverage exceeds residual and the local mechanical relation motif matches. The target receipt immediately clears the hint; actuator choice remains in the local wave collapse.

rules.name: smw_request_least_exposed_passive_effector_cycle
rules.comment: A caregiver opportunity is exafferent calibration, not an action. The graph requests the least-exposed situated channel.

rules.name: smw_record_noncontingent_passive_motion_without_handoff_credit
rules.comment: Motion of a different channel is real exafference, but it does not answer the graph's request and cannot unlock active control.

rules.name: smw_request_exafferent_support_baseline_calibration
rules.comment: Learn an external intervention as its own action model. The first reset-matched tonic observation measures passive body motion so it is not credited to caregiver support.

rules.name: smw_learn_exafferent_support_effect_by_baseline_residual
rules.comment: The support model owns only supported-minus-passive consequence. It remains output-null evidence until a later graph projection explicitly composes it with a child motor program.

rules.name: smw_advance_from_situated_motor_epoch
rules.comment: The boundary publishes a clock only. All structured activity is generated by the graph.

rules.name: smw_recover_and_homeostatically_charge_cells
rules.comment: Unused cells become more likely to ignite. Refractory cells recover from a topology-derived interval, preventing fixation.

rules.name: smw_homeostatic_ignition
rules.comment: Ignition is endogenous: the most deprived rested cell wins. No desired pose, limb name, random motor command or reward enters.

rules.name: smw_propagate_one_topological_hop
rules.comment: A current wavefront recruits adjacent rested cells for the next motor epoch. The one-epoch delay prevents fixpoint flooding.

rules.name: smw_collapse_current_wavefront_to_single_program
rules.comment: Massively parallel activity becomes one program which may control many effectors; there is never one decision per effector.

rules.name: smw_learn_wave_cell_from_verified_reafference
rules.comment: The body teaches the generator. A wave is productive if its verified receipt changes configuration, contact or orientation; no external reward or preferred pose is required.

rules.name: smw_reinforce_or_fractionate_coactive_wave_coupling
rules.comment: Only a verified receipt can change propagation. A productive coactivation strengthens the directed topological path; an unproductive one weakens it to zero, allowing assemblies to fractionate without inventing a fault class or host reward.

rules.name: smw_archive_receipt_processed_wave_program
rules.comment: A verified wave program remains causal evidence, but it is no longer part of the active field frontier. Keeping historical programs on the active edge made every subsequent action rescan the entire developmental history.
